title: parse.rs: gratuitous child_ids.clone() in build_part Multipart arm
description: parse.rs line 135: let ids: Vec<u32> = child_ids.clone() immediately clones the child index Vec from mail-parser, then iterates ids. The clone is unused after the immediately following iterator chain — child_ids could be iterated directly. For a message with 1000 MIME parts (e.g. a mailing list digest) this creates an unnecessary O(N) allocation of u32 values at every multipart level. Fix direction: iterate child_ids directly without cloning.
